Maria (support): FYI — Customer MNO opened a high-severity ticket: intermittent 403s + large p90 latency spikes. They say requests should hit us-west but traces show some tokens routed to eu-west. Also seeing unexpected egress billed on EU region.
Devon (sre): Can you paste a failing trace id and a failing curl? need to confirm header parity.
Maria (support): traceId=tr-0a1b2c3d, sample curl attached from their app: ```curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" -H \"Host: api.redwood.example\" \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate\"``` They say region pinned to us-west via SDK config.
Ashok (eng-runtime): Interesting — we recently pushed a fallback change in the L7 proxy where fallback to regional mirror uses Host header rewrite. If backend returns 5xx we rewrite Host -> mirror.local and set X-Preferred-Region to the fallback region. Could be overwriting the original X-Region header.
Elaine (infra): @Ashok that rollout was 2026-03-12 03:14 UTC (canary -> prod). Any chance header inheritance is async and conflicting with affinity cookies? :thinking_face:
Ashok (eng-runtime): Yep. I suspect an affinity/fallback loop: client hits us-west LB -> backend overload -> envoy rewrites host and attaches X-Region: eu-west -> request gets routed back through cross-region path and resets affinity, causing token-based routing to think EU is preferred.
Devon (sre): Can we reproduce locally? Steps requestable: set up gateway with upstream weights and force a 502 from us-west upstream. I can run a quick repro.
Maria (support): Customer provided a repro: local SDK config sets region=us-west, 10 requests -> 8 succeed us-west, 2 go to eu-west and 403 due to org-scoped auth mismatch. They want timeline and mitigation.
Ashok (eng-runtime): Minimal repro I used: ```# start envoy with test route, set upstream us-west: return 502, eu-west: return 200
curl -H \"Host: api.redwood.example\" -H \"X-Redwood-Region: us-west\" \"http://localhost:8080/v1/generate\" -I
``` After 2-3 failures envoy rewrites Host and X-Redwood-Region to eu-west when invoking mirror. log excerpt: ```[2026-03-14T12:03:21Z] route: /v1/generate -> fallback(mirror=eu-west) set-header X-Redwood-Region: eu-west```
Elaine (infra): That log line is consistent with the canary change. We intended to only add fallback metadata, not to override client-specified X-Redwood-Region. Looks like header-inheritance logic uses set-header rather than append/ preserve.
Devon (sre): Quick mitigation: rollback the canary or add a header-protection rule to preserve existing X-Redwood-Region. I can push a temporary rule to reject header rewrites for that header.
Ashok (eng-runtime): I'll open an urgent PR to change to `set_header_if_not_present` semantics in the Envoy config and a follow-up to ensure Host rewrite is isolated to internal mirror calls only.
Maria (support): Customer asks for ETA and whether we can map billing back to original region for those requests. Any chance we can patch billing classification by traceId?
Elaine (infra): We can retroactively mark those traces as us-west if we detect original X-Redwood-Region in ingress logs. Need SRE run a query on our access logs + traces. @Devon can you take ownership?
Devon (sre): On it. I'll run a log join: ingress logs (preserve-original-headers) x traceId -> if found original header = us-west, tag billing. ETA few hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: deploy status: rollback flag set on rollout 2026-03-12-canary -> pending manual approval.
Ashok (eng-runtime): PR opened: #5123 — change to set_header_if_not_present for X-Redwood-Region and isolate Host rewrite behind `internal_mirror` route. Requesting hotfix deploy.
Maria (support): I'll update the customer with repro steps + temporary mitigation: ask them to set explicit X-Redwood-Region header in their SDK while we hotfix, and let them know we're investigating billing attribution.
Devon (sre): After hotfix we should add an integration test simulating mirrored fallback and assert original region header remains unchanged. Also add a regression test for auth mismatch (403) when region changes mid-request.
Elaine (infra): Agreed. I'll schedule postmortem and mark the rollout change as the root cause candidate.
Maria (support): Thanks all. I'll keep the customer updated. If anyone finds this affects other headers (like X-Org or Cookie-based affinity) please flag here. :pray:
Ashok (eng-runtime): Noted. I'll scan other header rewrite rules for similar set vs set_if_not_present mistakes.
Devon (sre): tagging follow-ups: #oncall, #billing-team for attribution.
Maria (support): Closing loop: hotfix PR merged -> infra to deploy -> SRE to run billing mapping -> support to confirm with customer. Will post final status when done. :white_check_mark:
